breakdown.description: The prompt replaces the spatially varying area with its arithmetic mean and calls the result exact, even though the deformation integral depends on 1/A(x), not on the average area itself.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification still uses the arithmetic mean area approach (Ā = A₀·(1 + k/2) = 260 mm²) and computes δ = P·L/(E·Ā), which is exactly the flawed method identified in the inconsistency. The ground truth requires evaluating the exact integral δ = ∫[0→L] P/(A(x)E) dx with the spatially varying A(x), since the deformation depends on 1/A(x), not on the average area. The Agent repeated the original error rather than fixing it.
